subject: ophthalmology
title: Corneal degenerations, dystrophies and ectasias

steps.tx: **Keratoconus** thins the central cornea into a cone after puberty, usually bilateral but asymmetric, with vernal allergy, Down syndrome and eye rubbing associations. Progressive myopic astigmatism resists full correction by glasses while retinoscopy shows a scissors reflex. **Munson sign** bulges the lower lid on downgaze while Vogt striae, Fleischer iron ring and apical scarring confirm the cone. Topography diagnoses early disease, **corneal crosslinking** halts progression and rigid or scleral lenses rehabilitate vision. Acute hydrops from Descemet tear with sudden oedema needs hyperosmotics, then grafting for scars.
steps.say: Keratoconus thins the central cornea into a cone after puberty and it usually affects both eyes unevenly. Glasses fail to correct the rising myopic astigmatism and retinoscopy shows a scissors reflex that points to the cone. The lower lid bulges on downgaze while the cornea carries stress lines and an iron ring at the cone base. Topography confirms early cones, crosslinking halts progression and rigid or scleral lenses restore vision.

steps.tx: Endothelial failure clouds vision in the morning. **Fuchs dystrophy** shows guttae with Descemet thickening and blur that clears later in the day, then progresses to bullous keratopathy with painful ruptured bullae. Treatment uses hypertonic saline with bandage lenses and moves to endothelial keratoplasty with DSEK or DMEK. **Pseudophakic bullous keratopathy** follows complicated cataract surgery similarly. **Arcus senilis** forms a lipid ring with a clear interval as ageing physiology, but arcus before forty hunts hyperlipidaemia. Band keratopathy calcifies Bowman in chronic uveitis or hypercalcaemia and responds to EDTA chelation.
steps.say: The endothelium fails first thing in the morning with blur that clears toward noon. Fuchs dystrophy shows beaten metal guttae and it progresses to painful blisters when the surface breaks down. Hypertonic saline with a bandage lens soothes early disease and endothelial grafting replaces the failed layer. Surgery related bullous disease behaves the same way after a difficult cataract operation. A lipid ring with a clear gap means ageing, but the same ring before forty demands a lipid profile.

steps.tx: This slit lamp view shows **corneal guttae** as beaten metal dots on the endothelium with hazy **stromal oedema** glowing in the light beam. Guttae mark Fuchs dystrophy where the pump fails overnight, so vision blurs in the morning and clears later. Stromal haze signals waterlogged collagen that later forms painful bullae if the disease advances. The picture teaches the exam link between guttae, morning blur and endothelial grafting. Spotting guttae should prompt morning history with graft planning.
steps.say: This slit lamp view shows beaten metal guttae studding the endothelium with haze spreading through the stroma. The dots mark Fuchs dystrophy where the endothelial pump is weakened overnight. Vision therefore blurs in the morning and it is cleared as the day evaporates surface water. Persistent haze warns that painful blisters may follow, so early drops with later endothelial grafting preserve sight.

steps.tx: Stromal dystrophies deposit bilaterally and symmetrically with distinct textures. **Granular dystrophy** lays bread crumb deposits while macular dystrophy clouds with Descemet involvement in autosomal recessive inheritance and **lattice dystrophy** draws refractile lines with recurrent erosions and amyloid. Salzmann nodular degeneration raises bluish nodules after chronic surface disease. Terrien marginal degeneration thins the superior periphery with against the rule astigmatism. Keratoglobus balloons the whole cornea from birth with rupture risk. Phototherapeutic keratectomy smooths superficial deposits while deeper disease needs grafts.
steps.say: Stromal dystrophies deposit material in both corneas, which is seen as a mirror pattern. Granular disease scatters bread crumb deposits while lattice disease is the type that draws glassy lines and triggers repeated erosions. Macular dystrophy clouds deeper and it follows recessive inheritance with early visual loss. Nodular degeneration follows chronic surface disease and marginal thinning steepens one edge, so topography and slit lamp position separate them. Superficial deposits accept laser smoothing while deep deposits need a graft.

steps.tx: Limbal stem cell failure after chemical burns, Stevens Johnson syndrome or aniridia lets conjunctiva with vessels march over cornea with persistent defects. Amniotic membrane or stem cell transplantation rebuilds the surface because standard grafts fail without stem cells. **Pterygium** control prevents recurrence with conjunctival autografting since bare sclera techniques recur. Corneal tattooing and **keratoprosthesis** serve blind opaque corneas unsuitable for grafts. Kayser Fleischer rings place copper in Descemet and flag Wilson disease in young patients with movement disorders, unlike Fleischer iron rings of keratoconus.
steps.say: Stem cell failure lets conjunctiva with vessels creep across the cornea after burns or Stevens Johnson syndrome. Standard grafts fail in this setting because the surface cannot renew itself, so amniotic membrane or stem cell transplantation rebuilds the foundation first. Pterygium surgery adds a conjunctival autograft because bare removal is known to invite recurrence. A copper ring in Descemet membrane with tremor points to Wilson disease, while an iron ring at a cone base points to keratoconus.
